Each year, the tree produces 7 lemons that sell for $1.5 each:

$$7 \times \$1.5 = \$10.50 \text{ per year}$$

## Step 3: Determine years needed to recover the planting cost

$$\$90 \div \$7.50 = 12 \text{ years}$$

## Step 4: Verify

After 12 years, Carlos will have earned:
$$12 \times \$7.50 = \$90$$

This exactly covers the initial $90 planting cost. So after **12 years**, he breaks even, and in year 13 he begins earning money.
